body.name: Published global OVS staggered-DDD model
body.construction:
\(\mathcal M\) is the class of full-data laws \(Q\) satisfying consistency and no effect on ineligible units, global mean no anticipation for every finite \(a\in\mathcal G\) and every \(u<a\), and the following literal OVS-indexed condition: for every finite \(g\in\mathcal G\), every \(u\in\{g,\ldots,T\}\), and every \(c\in\mathcal C_u^{\mathrm{OVS}}=\{a\in\mathcal G:a>u\}\),
\[
\begin{aligned}
&E_Q[\Delta Y_u(\infty,1)\mid G=g,S=1,X]
-E_Q[\Delta Y_u(\infty,0)\mid G=g,S=0,X]\\
&\qquad=
E_Q[\Delta Y_u(\infty,1)\mid G=c,S=1,X]
-E_Q[\Delta Y_u(\infty,0)\mid G=c,S=0,X]
\end{aligned}
\]
almost surely.  Thus \(\mathcal M\) is the published global OVS class, not the target-localized clean-through-terminal model.
